title: Echoes of the Forgotten City
subtitle: Chapter One: The Lamplighters' Guildhall
intro: A hundred years ago, in a single night, every lamp in the city of Veyl went out.
By morning its people were gone. No one has lived there since. No one has ever learned why.
Last week, a letter found you. The paper was brittle, the ink brown with age.
It asked you to come to Veyl, to the Lamplighters' Guildhall. It asked you to bring a lantern.
